# openrouter.ai documentation — Guides — Best Practices

> 4 page(s) of openrouter.ai documentation — Guides under Best Practices. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Best Practices

- [Latency and Performance](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/best-practices/latency-and-performance.md): Understanding OpenRouter's performance characteristics and practical DX optimization recipes
- [Prompt Caching](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/best-practices/prompt-caching.md): To maximize cache hit rates, OpenRouter uses **provider sticky routing** to route your subsequent requests to the same provider endpoint after a cached request.
- [Reasoning Tokens](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/best-practices/reasoning-tokens.md): For models that support it, the OpenRouter API can return **Reasoning Tokens**, also known as thinking tokens.
- [Uptime Optimization](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/best-practices/uptime-optimization.md): OpenRouter tracks response times, error rates, and availability across all providers in real-time.
